$comment: The extras of omx-chorus's declaration: what its descriptor, omx-chorus.descriptor.json, has no word for (docs/declaration-as-descriptor.md). The two are the folder's hand-written files; tools/gen.mjs generates the rest and writes the travels the descriptor's links resolve to. Its parameters are by reference to omx-contract's chorus kernel and bind by name to omx-dsp's instance face. Control order, the descriptor's, is append-only.
description: The console's chorus: up to four voices read one modulated delay line, the right leg's sweep offset by the spread, mixed with the dry signal.

console.$comment: The OpenMixer console draws its chorus stage: the panel is the modulation panel (rateHz, depthMs, voices, mix, spread); the stage's chip in the FX row shows rateHz; the overview card shows the engage switch only.
